training_only_assessment.design_requirement: First retain the legacy baseline and a zero-weight observation control with exact tensor/prediction parity; predeclare one small coefficient and fresh seeds before seeing a new validation cohort.
training_only_assessment.eligible_generic_hypothesis: Test a bounded full-vocabulary source/combined consistency regularizer only at training sites where the source head predicts the authenticated training label. Keep ordinary reconstruction losses and gates unchanged.
fresh_validation_requirements: New literal paragraphs and clause-order/paraphrase combinations, disjoint by source/hash and template group from all prior training/development rows.
Preregister seen-combination and unseen-combination strata using training inventory only; do not insert previously observed development failures as training targets.
Use a separate development set for checkpoint selection and a blind final test panel evaluated once after choosing the objective.
Include authentic statutory spans as separately reviewed coverage evidence; authored fixtures do not establish federal-law or other-modality fidelity.
training_only_assessment.interpretation: Persistent disagreement in a correct training output could support testing regularization, but does not establish that recurrence is harmful. Source-wrong/combined-correct counts identify useful recurrent corrections that an unconditional penalty could damage.
